text.7:21: And he swore unto them (saying): Lo! I am a sincere adviser unto you.
text.7:68: I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and am for you a true adviser.
text.7:79: And (Salih) turned from them and said: O my people! I delivered my Lord's message unto you and gave you good advice, but ye love not good advisers.
text.12:11: They said: O our father! Why wilt thou not trust us with Joseph, when lo! we are good friends to him?
text.28:12: And We had before forbidden foster-mothers for him, so she said: Shall I show you a household who will rear him for you and take care of him?
text.28:20: And a man came from the uttermost part of the city, running. He said: O Moses! Lo! the chiefs take counsel against thee to slay thee; therefor escape. Lo! I am of those who give thee good advice.
